base64.name: Base64
base64.help: Encode upstream text as Base64 using UTF-8, or decode Base64 into UTF-8 text. Invalid Base64 or UTF-8 input is rejected.

httpRequest.name: HTTP request
httpRequest.bodyHelp: Send the text as entered. Set Content-Type in the headers when needed.

merge.name: Merge data
merge.help: Connect multiple inputs. Values are collected in connection order; arrays are expanded by one level and objects remain intact. No configuration is required.
merge.summary: Combine multiple inputs into one array

fieldInput.name: Field input
fieldInput.help: Text mode outputs the content as entered. JSON object mode parses the content into a JSON object.
